mapper.select: SELECT * FROM xsy_product_bundle_component WHERE bundle_sku_id = #{bundleSkuId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY component_sku_id, id

SELECT bc.component_sku_id AS componentSkuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, p.name AS productName, s.spec_name AS specName, s.sale_unit AS saleUnit, bc.quantity_per_bundle_sale_unit AS quantityPerBundleSaleUnit FROM xsy_product_bundle_component bc JOIN xsy_product_sku s ON s.id = bc.component_sku_id JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id WHERE bc.bundle_sku_id = #{bundleSkuId} AND bc.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY bc.component_sku_id, bc.id
SELECT * FROM xsy_product_bundle_component WHERE deleted = FALSE AND bundle_sku_id IN #{id} ORDER BY bundle_sku_id, component_sku_id, id
SELECT count(*) FROM xsy_product_bundle_component WHERE component_sku_id = #{componentSkuId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_product_bundle_component WHERE deleted = FALSE AND (bundle_sku_id IN #{id} OR component_sku_id IN #{id})
